<thought>I will search the template catalog for a reaction where a C‑C double bond is broken and a ketone together with a trimethylsilyl group are formed (the forward Peterson elimination). This will give a template that can be used in the retrosynthetic direction to convert the target alkene into a β‑silyl ketone.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
